title: Deployment Gate Triage: KPI Timeline & Ops Workbench
body:
Purpose:
This working sheet is an operational playbook for evaluating and progressing a feature through four deployment gates: Preflight, Canary, Ramp, and Scale. It ties concrete KPI thresholds to triage actions and a sample timeline so PMs, SRE, and Product Ops can make deterministic gate decisions.

Context and guidance (notes to reviewers):
- This is intentionally pragmatic: mix of measurement queries, quick checks, and go/no-go actions.
- Use Stripe-like acceptance style: if metric breaches persist beyond the measurement window, gate = HOLD and run the rollback play.
- Measurement windows default: Preflight/Canary = 60m, Ramp = 6h, Scale = 24h unless otherwise specified by the PM.
- If you update a KPI threshold, write a one-line rationale in the change log below.

Primary contacts:
- Gate owner: Avery Chen (product-ops)
- SRE/Monitor lead: Ravi Kapoor
- On-call escalation: @infra-oncall Slack channel
- Exec notifier: cc @head-of-prodops when a gate is blocked > 3h

Quick decision flow (one-liner):
1) Run prelim checklist (config, infra smoke). 2) Start Canary (percent). 3) Evaluate KPIs in window. 4) If stable, move to Ramp; if intermittent regressions, run mitigation/rollback. 5) At Ramp end, decision to Scale or revert.

GATE MATRIX (criteria, measurement, thresholds, actions)
---
Preflight (local QA + staging):
- Purpose: config sanity, schema, basic latency and error smoke.
- Measurement sources: staging logs, unit test suite, integration smoke runs.
- KPIs & thresholds:
  * Basic schema validation: 0 schema validation errors in staging for 12h
  * Smoke latency median (p50): < 120ms for synthetic 1k traffic samples
  * Error rate: < 0.25% (5xx / total)
- Actions on fail: stop promotion; tag as "needs-fix"; assign ticket to owning squad.
- Minimum signoffs: feature owner + infra engineer.

Canary (small % of traffic, live):
- Purpose: validate behavior under real requests without broad exposure.
- Traffic target: 0.5% - 2% depending on feature risk profile.
- Measurement window: 60 minutes (default).
- KPIs & thresholds (if any single KPI violates sustained for 3 consecutive 5m buckets -> triage):
  * Error rate (5xx): action if > 0.5% sustained
  * Latency p95: action if increases by > 2x baseline OR > 750ms absolute
  * Token generation rejection rate (for generation endpoints): action if > 1.5x baseline
  * Quality regression signal (A/B eval sample): action if degradation > 8% on sample prompts
- Triage actions:
  * Minor regressions: throttle canary traffic, increase logging, run targeted replay of failing requests
  * Severe regressions: immediate switch to rollback flavor, open SEV token, notify on-call

Ramp (increased exposure):
- Purpose: test scaling characteristics and longer-tailed issues.
- Traffic target: 5% -> 25% based on capacity tests and product tolerance.
- Measurement window: 6 hours.
- KPIs & thresholds (sustained over window):
  * Error rate: must remain < 0.4% averaged over window
  * Latency p95: must remain <= 1.5x baseline and <= 900ms absolute
  * Resource saturation: GPU mem pressure < 85% average, spike < 92%
  * Cost delta (estimated token-cost month-on-month): alert if > +18% projected
  * Customer-visible failures (support tickets): > 3 new tickets about this feature -> pause ramp
- Ramp actions:
  * If resource saturation seen: enable burst autoscaling policy, reduce batch sizes, or use fallback model variant
  * If quality drift: block further ramp and run focused eval set; consider canary rollback

Scale (global traffic shift):
- Purpose: full release with monitoring & guardrails for 24-72h.
- Measurement window: 24h (default), watch first 72h closely for latent signals.
- KPIs & thresholds:
  * Error rate: maintain < 0.35%
  * Latency p95: remain <= historical SLA (example: 800ms)
  * Unit cost delta: within validated tolerance per Optimize recommendation (default < +12%)
  * Business signal: engagement funnel conversion within +/- 5% of baseline
- Scale decisions: proceed to full rollout if all KPIs in bounds and no open SEV.

Decision actions quick reference:
- Green: all KPIs within thresholds -> PROCEED to next gate (document timestamp and who authorized).
- Yellow: intermittent or borderline -> SLOW RAMP or HOLD with mitigation plan (document metrics driving hold).
- Red: breach -> ROLLBACK (execute rollback runbook) and open postmortem.

Rollback runbook (short):
1) Switch traffic routing to previous stable variant (step-by-step CLI + console commands appended below).
2) Increase logging level on affected services for 1h to capture repro.
3) Attach forensic ticket: JIRA-PRODOPS-XXXX (use template).
4) Notify stakeholders: #prodops-alerts, exec cc if > 30 minutes unresolved.
5) Start RCA and preserve logs + golden trace IDs.

Sample measurement queries (copy / paste to alerts dashboard):
- error_rate_5xx = sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5..", route=~"/api/.*"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m]))
- p95_latency_ms = histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)) * 1000
- gpu_mem_pct = avg(gpu_memory_used_bytes / gpu_memory_total_bytes) by (instance) * 100
- gen_rejection_rate = sum(rate(gen_rejected_total[5m])) / sum(rate(gen_requests_total[5m]))

Operational timeline example (editable):
- Day 0 (09:00): Preflight complete -> promote to Canary 0.5% (owner: Avery)
- Day 0 (09:30-10:30): Canary monitoring window
- Day 0 (11:00): Canary review meeting (10m sync) -> decision to ramp to 5%
- Day 0 (12:00-18:00): Ramp monitoring (6h) -> pause if alerts
- Day 1 (09:00): Scale to 50% if Ramp OK; keep alert thresholds tightened for 48h

KPI quick table (paste into dashboards as single-number tiles):
- baseline_error_rate: 0.22%
- canary_action_threshold: 0.5%
- ramp_action_threshold: 0.4%
- scale_action_threshold: 0.35%
- baseline_p95_ms: 380
- p95_ramp_threshold_ms: 900
- cost_delta_threshold_scale: +12%

Operational play snippets (to copy into JIRA tasks):
- "Investigate gen_rejection_rate spike: attach 20 failing traces, run local replay against canary variant. Owner: SRE."
- "Throttle new feature: reduce traffic by 50% and enable fallback-model-with-cache for 2h. Owner: Product-ops."

Open questions / Todos (work-in-progress):
- Define exact sample prompt set for quality A/B checks (owner: Applied ML).
- Add analytics query for user-level abandonment within 5 minutes of feature exposure (owner: Growth).
- Formalize cost-accounting tag for experiments to map spend delta to feature (owner: Finance).

Change log (short):
- 2025-09-03: Initial draft (Avery)
- 2025-10-15: Tightened p95 ramp threshold after infra run (Ravi) - rationale: observed slower tails in multi-tenant tests
- 2025-11-02: Added cost delta thresholds and ticket templates (Sofia)

Attachments / snippets appended here for easy access:
- rollback-commands.txt (CLI):
  * rwi traffic set --route feature-x --variant stable --percent 100
  * rwi feature disable --feature-id feat-1234 --force
  * kubectl annotate deployment feature-x traffic-rollout=rollback --overwrite

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep this doc lean; if teams prefer a more visual board, we will port this to the product-ops Notion.
- Expect small deviations depending on legal/regulatory features (addition of privacy review gate).

End of sheet.
